nodes.name: Oscar arrives at production office
nodes.description: Oscar enters the production office carrying a canvas backpack and settles into the room with Diana.
evidence: Diana is at the desk. OSCAR enters carrying a CANVAS BACKPACK, which he drops over the back of a chair.

nodes.name: Diana moves opening night
nodes.description: Diana informs Oscar that opening night has been rescheduled to Saturday because new funding required another rehearsal day.
evidence:

evidence: Oscar sits and pulls the script from his canvas backpack.
